steps.instruction:
Welcome to the Video Reprocessing workspace!
When a video is processed, results are saved as CSV and NPZ files. This layout lets you replay and review tracking data synchronized with video playback.

Video Reader:
Displays your video files. Videos that have already been processed appear in green, indicating that their saved tracking data (.npz) is ready to replay.

Motility Reprocessor:
When you play a processed video, this module reads the .npz data and streams tracking metrics frame-by-frame in real-time sync with playback.

Video Viewer:
Displays the replayed video frames alongside reconstructed motion vectors and overlays.

Sample Container:
Automatically captures re-emitted data series during playback, allowing you to compare, organize, and re-export runs.
Lineplot: Plots motility curves dynamically in direct synchronization with the video playback scrubber.

Polar Plot:
Simultaneously reconstructs angular distributions and directionality vectors as the video plays.

You are now ready to reprocess and review your experiment runs!
Select any processed (green) video in the Video Reader and hit Play to inspect its metrics in sync.
